## 7. User Personas


- **Customer:** Inquires about product troubleshooting via self-contained web chat.
- **Customer Service Representative:** Handles complex inquiries and low-confidence escalations with 3-bullet context summary.

## 10. Product Scope


- Grounded knowledge-base question and answer retrieval
- Multi-turn conversation session history management
- Low-confidence answer detection below 80.0% threshold
- Automated delivery suppression for answers < 80.0%
- Human customer service representative escalation routing with 3-bullet summary


## 11. Out of Scope


- External third-party ticketing platforms (Zendesk, Jira)
- External CRM synchronization (Salesforce, HubSpot)
- Telephony, voice calls, and phone hotline IVR
- Multilingual speech translation


## 12. Functional Requirements


| ID | Title | Description | Priority | Traceable AC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **FR-001** | Grounded Knowledge-Base Q&A | Retrieves answers exclusively from approved knowledge-base articles | Must Have | AC-001, AC-002 |
| **FR-002** | Conversation Session History | Preserves multi-turn conversation context across dialogue turns in active session memory | Must Have | AC-003, AC-004 |
| **FR-003** | Low-Confidence Answer Detection | Evaluates confidence against 80.0% threshold and routes low-confidence answers to human escalation | Must Have | AC-005, AC-006 |
| **FR-004** | Human Agent Escalation Routing | Transfers full transcript and structured 3-bullet context summary to human representative | Must Have | AC-007, AC-008 |
| **FR-005** | Escalation Resolution Ledger | Commits agent disposition notes and session resolution timestamp to audit ledger | Should Have | AC-009 |


#### Detailed Functional Requirement Specifications


#### FR-001: Grounded Knowledge-Base Q&A


- **Actor:** Customer
- **System Behavior:** Retrieves approved passages and formats verified response.
- **Provenance:** `confirmed_user_input` (User Input: answers customer questions using approved knowledge-base articles)


#### FR-002: Conversation Session History


- **Actor:** Customer
- **System Behavior:** Preserves multi-turn dialogue context in session cache; long-term archival duration is an open decision.
- **Provenance:** `confirmed_user_input` (User Input: maintains conversation history)


#### FR-003: Low-Confidence Answer Detection


- **Actor:** AI Evaluation Engine
- **System Behavior:** Suppresses answers below 80.0% confidence and routes to internal escalation queue.
- **Provenance:** `confirmed_user_input` (User Input: identifies low-confidence answers below 80%)

## 15. User Journeys


1. **Customer Query Ingestion:** Customer submits question in web chat; system retrieves matching approved KB passages.
2. **Threshold Evaluation:** Evaluates candidate answer confidence against 80.0% threshold; if >= 80.0%, delivers grounded response with article citations.
3. **Low-Confidence Escalation:** If confidence is strictly below 80.0%, system suppresses direct response, compiles 3-bullet summary, and transfers to human representative queue.
4. **Agent Resolution:** Representative reviews complete transcript with summary and resolves customer inquiry.


## 16. Business Rules


| ID | Rule Title | Operational Statement | Provenance | Source Reference | Rationale | Confirmation Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **BR-001** | Grounded Knowledge Base Answers | Answers must be derived strictly from approved articles with source citations | `confirmed_user_input` | User Input: approved knowledge-base articles | Prevents hallucinations | No (Confirmed) |
| **BR-002** | 80% Confidence Escalation Threshold | Responses with confidence score below 80.0% must be suppressed and escalated | `confirmed_user_input` | User Input: identifies low-confidence answers below 80% | Protects customer trust | No (Confirmed) |
| **BR-003** | Multi-Turn Context Retention | Chat session history must be preserved across conversation turns | `confirmed_user_input` | User Input: maintains conversation history | Contextual continuity | No (Confirmed) |
| **BR-004** | Agent Handoff Summary | Escalated sessions must deliver complete transcript and 3-bullet summary to representative | `confirmed_user_input` | User Input: escalates complex queries with summary | Reduces triage latency | No (Confirmed) |
| **BR-005** | Chat Retention Policy (Open Decision) | Archival transcript retention duration beyond 24-hour cache is subject to privacy review | `unresolved_decision` | Unresolved Decision: Data Retention Policy | Statutory compliance | Yes (Review needed) |

## 18. Data Requirements


- Core entities: CustomerSession, ChatMessage, KBArticleReference, EscalationTicket, ResolutionAudit.
- Active chat session state is cached up to 24 hours; archival retention duration is documented as an Open Architectural Decision pending privacy review.

## 20. Security and Privacy Requirements


- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across all endpoints.
- Data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256.
- Statutory regulatory compliance (GDPR, FERPA, HIPAA) marked as Open Decision pending institutional legal review.


## 21. Acceptance Criteria


| AC ID | Associated Requirement | Acceptance Criteria (Given-When-Then / Rule) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **AC-001** | FR-001 | Given a customer submits a question, When evaluated against the knowledge base, Then answers cite approved source article references. |
| **AC-002** | FR-001 | Given an answer candidate with no approved KB article, When evaluated, Then automated answer is suppressed and customer offered human escalation. |
| **AC-003** | FR-002 | Given a multi-turn chat session, When customer asks a follow-up question, Then conversation context from previous turns is preserved. |
| **AC-004** | FR-002 | Given an active chat session, When session continues across dialogue turns, Then transcript continuity is maintained in session memory. |
| **AC-005** | FR-003 | Given an answer candidate with evaluated confidence of 79.9% (< 80.0%), When evaluated, Then automatic response is prohibited and query is escalated to a human agent with conversation summary. |
| **AC-006** | FR-003 | Given an answer candidate with evaluated confidence of exactly 80.0%, When evaluated, Then automatic response is permitted and delivered to customer. |
| **AC-007** | FR-004 | Given an answer candidate with evaluated confidence of 80.1%, When evaluated, Then automatic response is permitted with verified article citations. |
| **AC-008** | FR-004 | Given an escalation event occurs, When transferred to a representative, Then the agent dashboard receives the full transcript and structured 3-bullet summary without prompting customer to re-enter issue details. |
| **AC-009** | FR-005 | Given a human representative completes inquiry handling, When ticket is resolved, Then disposition notes and handling duration are committed to permanent audit ledger. |
